class_reason: All five Table 1 targets reproduce to the printed rounding with the authors' pinned fixest 0.11.1; the full regenerated h1 table matches Table 1 coefficients, SEs, stars, N 138, 62 countries and R2. confidence_reason: Deterministic OLS, authors' pinned estimation package, script ran end to end with two unused library() lines removed; pending agreement with agent B.
uncertainties: vctrs 0.5.1 (readme pin) could not be used at run time; dplyr 1.0.9 with vctrs 0.6.5 is a combination the authors did not have. Estimates are deterministic OLS and match, so this is unlikely to matter.
Current CRAN fixest was not run as a comparison (PREREG makes it optional, only if 0.11.1 fails to build). With 0.11.1, N is 138 with 62 country groups, so no singleton drop occurred.
R_c (no country FE) gives a smaller, non-significant coefficient (see robustness); this is a pre-registered alternative specification and does not change the class.
